title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ يحاضر في العاصمة القطرية ضمن أنشطة بشائر الرحمة
title_en: The Sheikh Lectures in the Qatari Capital as Part of the Bashāʾir al-Raḥmah Programme
body_ar: ألقى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن بن الددو- يوم أمس الاحد 8 رمضان 1435هـ الموافق 06 يوليو 2014مـ سلسة دروس ومحاضرات في العاصمة القطرية الدوحة وذلك ضمن أنشطة فعاليات بشائر الرحمة التي تنظمها مؤسسة الشيخ ثاني بن عبد الله للخدمات الإنسانية ( راف) سنويا بمناسبة شهر رمضان و قد توزعت دروس فضيلة الشيخ على النحو التالي : خاطرة بعد صلاة العصر بمسجد روضة العطية بمنطقة الوعب خاطرة تخللت صلاة التراويح بمسجد حصة السويدي بمنطقة الوعب محاضرة الساعة العاشرة مساء بقاعة الشعلة حول موضوع: رفقا بالقوارير
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan ibn al-Dedew gave, yesterday, Sunday 8 Ramadan 1435 AH, corresponding to 06 July 2014, a series of lessons and lectures in the Qatari capital, Doha, as part of the Bashāʾir al-Raḥmah programme of events, which the Sheikh Thani bin Abdullah Foundation for Humanitarian Services (RAF) organises each year on the occasion of the month of Ramadan.

The Sheikh's lessons were arranged as follows:

A short reflection after the afternoon prayer at Rawdat al-Atiyah Mosque in the al-Waab district.
A short reflection given during the tarāwīḥ prayer at Hissa al-Suwaidi Mosque in the al-Waab district.
A lecture at ten in the evening in the Shuʿlah hall, on the subject: 'Gently with the glass vessels'.

flags.context: the title of the evening lecture
options: 'Gently with the glass vessels' — the prophetic phrase, left as an image
'Be Gentle with Women' — the phrase's referent, made explicit
flags.note: The phrase is the Prophet's word to Anjashah, who was driving the camels carrying the women too quickly; القوارير, glass vessels, stands for the women. Kept as the image, because it is the lecture's title and an English reader who is told only 'Be Gentle with Women' loses the allusion the title depends on. A subtitle giving the sense would serve the reader better than replacing the image. The record does not say what the lecture contained.

flags.context: the name of the annual Ramadan programme
options: Bashāʾir al-Raḥmah, left as a programme name
flags.note: Left as the organisation's own programme name; the sense is 'the first glad tidings of mercy'. A reviewer may prefer to gloss it on first occurrence.

translator_notes: A schedule notice. No content of any of the three talks is given.
خاطرة is a short reflection or homily, briefer than a lesson; rendered so rather than as 'lecture', which the same record uses for محاضرة.
The record's internal date, Sunday 6 July 2014, is the day before the CMS stamp of Monday 7 July.
